method: Implementer opened official pages with web reader; separate researcher supplied direct official-screen observations as a research supplement. These are documentation observations, not hands-on shipping-game tests. No game pixel measurements were performed.

sources.title: Minecraft 1.21.70 Bedrock Changelog
sources.verification: Implementer read official Pause Feature and User Interface sections on 2026-10-07. Separate researcher's pause-menu placement observation was received, but its exact image URL is not catalogued here and no empirical position claim uses it.
sources.observation: Pausing applies when alone in an owned local world; joining resumes it, with a notification. Realms/servers and playing with a friend are excluded. Notes also fix continuing diagonal touch movement after opening a menu.
sources.proposal: Explicit local active/paused/interrupted status, input blocking while inventory owns focus, held-input rearming and separately specified online behavior.
sources.limits: No inventory-pause inference, all-editions universal rule, current hands-on game test or exact game geometry. Original diagram shows conditions rather than a reproduction of a game screen.

sources.title: Getting Started / Data Center Selection
sources.verification: Official page text and linked title/region/data-center image URLs resolved by implementer; title/server pixel placement observations supplied by separate researcher.
sources.observation: Manual separates data-center region selection, associated worlds, and character creation. Researcher observed a Dawntrail title's centered vertical list and server-selection Back/Proceed grouping.
sources.proposal: Left/center title rails; local route and call sign before connection; stable explicit Back.
sources.limits: No exact title/game coordinates, authentication simulation, or current hands-on test. Title differs with account entitlement according to the manual.

sources.title: Navigating the Game Screen
sources.verification: Official page text opened and read by implementer on 2026-10-07.
sources.observation: Describes a top-right minimap, clickable gear/inventory groups, menu categories, inventory equipment/use/sort actions and HUD layout adjustment.
sources.proposal: Separate hub and play scenes; right map + distinct bag opener; explicit collection/detail navigation.
sources.limits: Our frame, icon art, panel position, gap and target sizes are authored proposals. No original-game pixel geometry measured.

sources.title: Waypoint Update
sources.verification: Official page text opened and inventory sections read by implementer on 2026-10-07.
sources.observation: Technology and Cargo are displayed together; inventory sections can scroll and items can be filtered by type.
sources.proposal: Stable category controls and scrollable collection; portrait uses collection/detail sequentially.
sources.limits: Our 12 items, split width, column count, item actions and pause contract are original. No current No Man's Sky client test.

sources.title: Let's Play in Fortnite Creative
sources.version_scope: November 2023 documented lobby image; not a current-game claim
sources.verification: English official page opened by implementer; actual asset pixels inspected by separate researcher and supplied as a research supplement on 2026-10-07.
sources.observation: Bright Play action lower left under selected mode and ranked/party settings. Top PLAY tab returns to lobby and is not the matchmaking action.
sources.proposal: Keep context with progression and distinguish navigation from starting a session.
sources.limits: No universal bottom-right/lower-left claim, copied layout, downloaded screenshot, exact source-game dimensions or current build test.

sources.publisher: The Pokémon Company / Pokémon GO Plus + official website
sources.title: Playing with Pokémon GO
sources.verification: Official page opened by implementer; source screen pixels inspected by separate researcher and supplied as a research supplement on 2026-10-07.
sources.observation: World menu opener bottom-center; following menu has Settings top-right, choices lower half, Items lower-right and Close bottom-center.
sources.proposal: Compare a portrait lower action hub with an upper-middle stack; make Back/Close explicit.
sources.limits: No measured thumb reach, universal portrait rule, exact game target size, or current-game verification.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 112: UI navigation
sources.version_scope: Document page last updated 2026-03-04; Forza Horizon 4 examples
sources.verification: Official page read by implementer; separate researcher supplied tile/list observations on 2026-10-07. A separately reported unsaved-dialog reference lacks its exact URL here and is not used as a sourced claim.
sources.observation: Contrasts Forza Horizon 4 multidirectional tiles with linear difficulty settings; describes intuitive directional focus, consistent repeated navigation, and layout-aware reflow.
sources.proposal: Spatial arrows for item grids and HUD controls; linear action rails. Our cancel-first return dialog is independently authored.
sources.limits: Target sizes and repeat cadence are proposals. The demo clamps linear ends; XAG also recommends configurable looping for linear menus. Complete XAG compliance, physical controller and assistive technology untested.
